answer.text:
According to Utz Brands, Inc.'s Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 29, 2024 (Item 7, *Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations*), the figures are as follows:

### **Reported Figures (in thousands/millions):**
* **Net sales:** $1,409,281 thousand (or $1,409.3 million)
* **Gross profit:** $494,777 thousand (or $494.8 million)

---

### **Calculation:**
$$\text{Gross Profit Margin} = \frac{\text{Gross profit}}{\text{Net sales}} = \frac{\$494,777}{\$1,409,281} \approx 35.1085\% \approx 35.1\%$$

Utz Brands, Inc. also explicitly states in the text:
> *"Our gross profit margin was 35.1% for the fiscal year ended December 29, 2024 versus 31.7% for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023."*

**Source:** 
* Accession: `0001739566-25-000053`, Item 7, Chunk ID: `14e6d7a8-d96c-5bc1-a7d5-febc26908e92`
